name: warboss-horde
description: A model-aware delegation framework. The main agent acts as WARBOSS: it builds a model ladder from tiers.json (N available models -> N rungs), routes each task to the cheapest rung that can satisfy it by residual entropy, and dispatches a single generic `doer` subagent at the chosen model — so the expensive model only decides and the cheapest model does the work. A Bash-capable `runner` subagent executes verify commands and mechanical ops in a thin cheap context, so checks never replay the orchestrator's transcript.
